title: Name a foreground NERV when an update is refused
goal: An update refused because NERV runs as a foreground nerv launch says so, names the process and the way forward
acceptance: A committed test fails first: after a service move, with the service not registered and a foreground nerv launch (global link, other checkout) serving the base, the outside updater's refusal names the foreground process instead of the generic ownership reason, and nothing is stopped
Process discovery finds a NERV runtime started through the global nerv command
A moved, registered service is observed owned and the update preview only asks to stop it first
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: A committed regression fails before the fix (test/update-foreground-runtime.test.ts)
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: live diagnosis, a failing join test, a matcher and message fix. Not a measurement.
